# Introduction {#sec-intro}

```{r}
#| label: load_packages
#| include: false
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(tsibble)
library(feasts)
library(fable)
```

Aim:
This study aims to evaluate current sortition methods and representative community processes, with a focus on the LexiMin algorithm, and to investigate how unobserved traits and survey non-response may affect panel representativeness. By understanding these factors, we can develop a greater understanding of current tools and procedures, how they work, how they fall short, and what it would mean for them to be more representative.
